title: 101. Kth Largest Element in a Stream

examples.explanation: KthLargest kthLargest = new KthLargest(3, [4, 5, 8, 2]); kthLargest.add(3); // return 4 kthLargest.add(5); // return 5 kthLargest.add(10); // return 5 kthLargest.add(9); // return 8 kthLargest.add(4); // return 8
KthLargest kthLargest = new KthLargest(4, [7, 7, 7, 7, 8, 3]); kthLargest.add(2); // return 7 kthLargest.add(10); // return 7 kthLargest.add(9); // return 7 kthLargest.add(9); // return 8

hints: Keep only the k largest values seen so far.
A min-heap of size k exposes the current kth largest value at its root.
Insert each value, remove the heap minimum when its size exceeds k, and record the root after every addition.
